settings.name_in_paper: K-armed Gaussian bandit with deep hierarchical Gaussian prior (tree T)
unmapped: Arm means generated by a known tree-structured hierarchical Gaussian model: theta_i | theta_pa(i) ~ N(theta_pa(i), sigma_{0,i}^2), root ~ N(mu_1, sigma_{0,1}^2); learner knows the tree and all prior variances
settings.definition_quote: The analysis is for the Gaussian model in \cref{sec:mab posteriors}. ... We start with a $K$-armed Gaussian bandit. In this setting, each node $i \in \cV$ is associated with a single scalar parameter $\theta_{*, i} \in \realset$, and its initial uncertainty is described by conditional prior variance $\Sigma_{0, i} = \sigma_{0, i}^2$.

symbols.G_T: complexity term E[sum_t sigma_{t,A_t}^2], expected sum of marginal posterior variances of the played actions
symbols.sigma_max: maximum marginal prior standard deviation at an action node
symbols.delta: free analysis parameter delta > 0 (not a failure probability)

source.label: lem:bayes regret
source.quote: For any $\delta > 0$, the Bayes regret of \hierts is bounded as \Bregret(n) \leq \sqrt{2 n \cG(n) \log(1 / \delta)} + \sqrt{2 / \pi} \sigma_{\max} K n \delta, where $\cG(n) = \E{}{\sum_{t = 1}^n \sigma_{t, A_t}^2}$ denotes a complexity term...

results.notes: Intermediate bound in terms of an algorithm-dependent complexity term; Theorem gives an explicit bound on G.

symbols.G_T: sum over tree nodes i of c^{h_i} w_i; for leaves w_i = sigma_{0,i}^2/log(1+sigma_{0,i}^2/sigma^2) * log(1+sigma_{0,i}^2 n/sigma^2); for internal nodes w_i = sigma_{0,i}^2/log(1+sigma_{0,i}^2/sigma^2) * log(1+sigma_{0,i}^2 sum_{j in ch(i)} sigma_{0,j}^{-2})
symbols.sigma_max: maximum marginal prior standard deviation at an action node
symbols.c_scale: c in the theorem: constant with c*sigma_hat_{t,i}^{-2} >= sigma_hat_{t+1,i}^{-2}; c = 1 + sigma_{0,max}^2/sigma^2 suffices (c=2 if sigma >= sigma_{0,max})
symbols.h_i: height of node i in the tree

conditions: Gaussian hierarchical prior over arm means given by a tree; exact posterior sampling with known prior and noise variance

source.label: thm:regret bound
source.quote: For any $\delta > 0$, the Bayes regret of \hierts is bounded as \Bregret(n) \leq \sqrt{2 n \cG(n) \log(1 / \delta)} + \sqrt{2 / \pi} \sigma_{\max} K n \delta, where $\cG(n) = \sum_{i \in \cV} c^{h_i} w_i$ and $c$ is a scalar defined in \eqref{eq:posterior scaling}.
